description.value: A remote, reservation-only waterfront group site on Florence Lake Forest Service Road with a dock for paddling and fishing; no tap water, no garbage service, and key pickup is required at Rock Creek 9 km away. The active industrial gravel FSR has bumps, potholes, and seasonal mud — a rough loaded-bike ride in.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and confirms this is a group-only, remote waterfront campsite reached via ~10 km of gravel Florence Lake Forest Service Road. Multiple website passages explicitly confirm no potable water ('potable water are not provided'), no electricity ('none of the sites have electricity, sewer or any type of water tap'), and no showers, while reservations are confirmed as accepted via an online booking system. The OSM tag group_only=yes is directly corroborated by the website's occupancy cap of 24 and group reservation model requiring key pickup from a host at Rock Creek.
concerns: Site is group_only=yes per OSM and confirmed by website; individual touring cyclists cannot book independently.
Access requires ~10 km of rough gravel Florence Lake Forest Service Road described as having 'bumps and potholes' and potential mud — challenging for touring bicycles.
Key pickup logistics require visiting the host at Rock Creek before reaching the campsite, adding complexity for cyclists.
No address provided in OSM record.
No phone number provided in OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a group-only campsite (max 24 people, group reservations required) accessed via ~10 km of rough gravel forest service road with no services — it is poorly suited for individual touring cyclists and would only be relevant for organized cycling groups with support vehicles.

wow_evidence: group-only, remote waterfront campsite reached via ~10 km of gravel Florence Lake Forest Service Road
